summary: Ubuntu 16.04 (Xenial Xerus) was the sixth LTS release. Standard support ended 30 April 2021; ESM until 2026-04-21 for Ubuntu Pro. Features: Snap packages, ZFS experimental support, GCC 5, Python 3.5, LXD 2.0. The xerus (African ground squirrel) suggested friendliness and reliability. Widely used in cloud and containers.
notes: Standard support ended 2021-04-30. ESM until 2026-04-21 for Ubuntu Pro. Kernel 4.4. Xenial was the first LTS with snap support and remained a default base for many Docker images.
